limitations: A single synthetic fixture cannot establish object-class generality.
Controller events are not the beta-2013 iteration unit.
The result is not an exact reproduction of a published artifact.
This computational matrix does not constitute physical print validation.
claim.statement: This run measures the modern implementation on one original synthetic fixture.

paper_reference.scope: Algorithmic ablation context only; no paper value is pooled with local measurements.

algorithm.thread_policy: OMP/BLAS thread-count environment fixed to one

metric_definitions.definition: Final projected balance-target energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.
metric_definitions.name: projected_target_energy

metric_definitions.definition: Final inward cavity volume divided by final outer-envelope volume; reported only for an empty or strictly valid inner boundary.
metric_definitions.name: final_cavity_volume_fraction

metric_definitions.definition: Initial material mass minus final material mass, divided by initial material mass; deformation can make this value negative.
metric_definitions.name: material_mass_change_fraction

metric_definitions.definition: Final unscaled Laplacian shape energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.
metric_definitions.name: deformation_energy

metric_definitions.definition: RMS source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.
metric_definitions.name: normalized_rms_displacement

metric_definitions.definition: Maximum source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.
metric_definitions.name: normalized_maximum_displacement

metric_definitions.definition: Maximum absolute deviation of a user-handle uniform scale from one.
metric_definitions.name: maximum_handle_scale_deviation

metric_definitions.definition: Count of committed R10 geometry states, including the initial state.
metric_definitions.name: committed_event_count

metric_definitions.definition: Count of recorded carving iterations under the modern controller semantics.
metric_definitions.name: carving_iteration_count

metric_definitions.definition: Count of recorded deformation line-search iterations.
metric_definitions.name: deformation_iteration_count

metric_definitions.definition: One when the native result classifies the optimization outcome as successful.
metric_definitions.name: algorithm_success

metric_definitions.definition: One when all declared final balance targets are reached.
metric_definitions.name: targets_reached

metric_definitions.definition: One when the sealed manufacturing audit reports ready.
metric_definitions.name: manufacturing_ready

metric_definitions.definition: Minimum audited outer-to-inner clearance when a cavity exists and the audit completes.
metric_definitions.name: measured_minimum_wall_clearance

preprocessing.normalization: none; fixture coordinates are passed unchanged to the native facade

seed_policy.use: audit identifiers and timing repeats; the optimizer is deterministic

deviations: The fixture is repository-authored rather than a model from the paper.
The adaptive local voxel grid differs from the publication fixed cubic grid.
The modern guarded carving and manufacturing audits postdate the beta implementation.

resources.description: Exact loaded _make_it_stand extension binary for this case.
